Le Système international, les préfixes e: The International System, prefixes and the sizes of the world.
Sept unités de base du SI : mètre, kilog: Seven SI base units: meter, kilogram, second, ampere, kelvin, mole, candela. Since 2019, all are defined by constants.
Préfixes : kilo 10³, méga 10⁶, giga 10⁹,: Prefixes: kilo 10³, mega 10⁶, giga 10⁹, tera 10¹²; milli 10⁻³, micro 10⁻⁶, nano 10⁻⁹.

Les tailles du monde en puissances de 10: The sizes of the world in powers of 10
1re loi : sans force nette, un objet gar: 1st law: with no net force, an object keeps its velocity. Motion doesn't need a force to continue.
2e loi : F = m × a. La même force accélè: 2nd law: F = m × a. The same force accelerates a more massive object less.
3e loi : action et réaction sont égales: 3rd law: action and reaction are equal and opposite, and act on two different objects.
Dans le vide, une plume et un marteau to: In a vacuum, a feather and a hammer fall together (David Scott on the Moon, 1971).
Un objet lancé n'emporte pas de « force: A thrown object doesn't carry a “force of the throw”: once released, only weight and air act on it.
F = m × a : la force change la vitesse,: F = m × a: force changes velocity, not the fact of moving
Première loi de Newton : sans force nett: Newton's first law: with no net force, velocity doesn't change
Énergie cinétique et potentielle, puissa: Kinetic and potential energy, power, conservation.
Énergie cinétique ½ m v² : doubler la vi: Kinetic energy ½ m v²: doubling the speed quadruples the energy, and the braking distance.
Énergie potentielle de pesanteur m g h :: Gravitational potential energy m g h: it turns into kinetic energy during a fall.
L'énergie se conserve : elle change de f: Energy is conserved: it changes form (heat, motion, light) but doesn't disappear.
La puissance est un débit d'énergie : 1: Power is a rate of energy: 1 watt = 1 joule per second.
À 100 km/h, l'énergie n'est pas deux foi: At 100 km/h, the energy isn't twice that at 50 km/h but four times.
Son, lumière, fréquences, couleurs et ef: Sound, light, frequencies, colors and the Doppler effect.
Une onde transporte de l'énergie sans tr: A wave carries energy without carrying matter. Speed = wavelength × frequency.
Le son a besoin d'un milieu (≈ 340 m/s d: Sound needs a medium (≈ 340 m/s in air); light crosses a vacuum (≈ 300,000 km/s).
Lumière visible : de 400 nm (violet) à 7: Visible light: from 400 nm (violet) to 700 nm (red). Shorter wavelength, more energy.
Effet Doppler : une source qui s'approch: Doppler effect: an approaching source sounds higher-pitched, a receding one lower.
Le ciel est bleu parce que l'air diffuse: The sky is blue because air scatters short wavelengths more, not because it reflects the sea.
Spectre visible du violet (400 nm) au ro: Visible spectrum from violet (400 nm) to red (700 nm)
Pression, poussée d'Archimède, flottaiso: Pressure, Archimedes' buoyancy, floating and flows.
Pression = force ÷ surface. Une aiguille: Pressure = force ÷ area. A needle pierces because its area is tiny.
Sous l'eau, la pression augmente d'envir: Underwater, pressure rises by about 1 bar every 10 meters.
Archimède : tout corps plongé reçoit une: Archimedes: any immersed body receives an upward thrust equal to the weight of the fluid it displaces.
Un objet flotte si sa masse volumique mo: An object floats if its average density is lower than that of the liquid: a steel liner is full of air.
Un glaçon qui fond dans un verre plein n: An ice cube melting in a full glass doesn't make it overflow: it was already displacing its weight in water.
Température, chaleur, entropie et machin: Temperature, heat, entropy and heat engines.
Température et chaleur diffèrent : la te: Temperature and heat differ: temperature measures agitation, heat is a transfer of energy.
La chaleur va spontanément du chaud vers: Heat flows spontaneously from hot to cold (second law).
L'entropie d'un système isolé ne diminue: The entropy of an isolated system doesn't decrease: that's why a broken egg doesn't stick back together.
Une machine thermique ne convertit jamai: A heat engine never converts all heat into work: Carnot efficiency sets the limit.
Le métal paraît plus froid que le bois à: Metal feels colder than wood at the same temperature: it draws heat from your hand faster.
seule la différence est convertie en tra: only the difference is converted into work
Une machine thermique prend de la chaleu: A heat engine takes heat from the hot side, gives part of it back to the cold side
Vitesse de la lumière, temps dilaté, E =: Speed of light, dilated time, E = mc² and Einstein's gravitation.
La vitesse de la lumière dans le vide es: The speed of light in a vacuum is the same for all observers: 299,792,458 m/s.
Le temps passe plus lentement pour une h: Time passes more slowly for a fast-moving clock (time dilation).
E = mc² : la masse est une forme d'énerg: E = mc²: mass is a form of energy; a little mass contains an enormous amount of energy.
Relativité générale : la gravitation cou: General relativity: gravitation curves spacetime. GPS corrects about 38 µs per day.
Rien de massif ne peut atteindre la vite: Nothing with mass can reach the speed of light: the energy needed becomes infinite.
Le facteur de dilatation du temps explos: The time dilation factor explodes near the speed of light
Photons, dualité onde-particule, incerti: Photons, wave-particle duality, uncertainty and atoms.
La lumière est faite de photons ; l'éner: Light is made of photons; a photon's energy is proportional to its frequency (E = h f).
Dualité onde-particule : électrons et ph: Wave-particle duality: electrons and photons interfere, like waves, and arrive one by one, like grains.
Principe d'incertitude : on ne peut conn: Uncertainty principle: you cannot know both the exact position and the exact velocity of a particle.
Dans un atome, l'électron n'a que certai: In an atom, the electron only has certain energy levels; it emits a photon when it drops a level.
L'incertitude n'est pas un défaut des in: Uncertainty isn't a flaw of instruments: it's a property of nature.
Expérience des fentes d'Young : des part: Young's double-slit experiment: particles that interfere
